parts.purpose: The camera's ISP on the GPU, library side only: Nord2Metal.bundle/libredwoodair.dylib replaced by y2s39 = the installed y2s38 library (reproduced bit for bit from gpu/build/y2s-stage0/build-nord2 + gpu/build/y2s38-gpuycbcr/obj/air_metal.o) with one object changed: air_metal.c now includes air_isp.c, which adds the rwa_isp_* calls (gpu/build/camera-userland-20261109/GPU_ISP_API.md, src/rwa_isp_api.h). Nothing existing changes and nothing calls the new code until the camera bundle looks it up. Nord2Metal itself is NOT changed (checked to be the y2s38 one). Previous library kept as /private/var/db/nord2-metal/libredwoodair.dylib.pre-gpuisp; receipt.json inventory updated. Undo: guest-gpuisp-undo.sh.

camera, the dual-wide device (both back sensors at once): D22/AVCaptureSession.plist gets the virtual entry built-in_video:6 (deviceType 8, AVCaptureDeviceTypeBuiltInDualWideCamera: synchronizedStreamUniqueIDs :0 wide + :5 ultra-wide), made by camera-userland-20261109/tools/make_camera_plists.py from the stock iPhone X file; the three-camera file that is there is kept as AVCaptureSession.plist.pre-camdual. And /private/var/mobile/Library/Preferences/com.apple.camera.plist gets the preferences that keep Camera.app -- told by the kernel that it runs on an iPhone 11 (hw.model N104AP for the program Camera) -- from asking for what this capture device does not have: responsive shutter, capture and view outside the frame (which would need the hidden camera's pictures all the time), auto low-light video, content-aware distortion correction, scene detection, the one-time switch of Live Photo to automatic; the file as it was is kept as com.apple.camera.plist.pre-camdual (or its absence noted). CameraSetup.plist is not changed. Undo: guest-camdual-undo.sh with payload-camdual-undo and owned-camdual-undo.json.
